description: YuE2 Studio on Steroids. All-in-One YuE2 Songs Creator and Music Generation is the Ruach Studio. In-house finetunes of YuE2-3B SOTA Model. Creator, Writer, Refiner with DAW, Artist, Videographer, LoRA Trainer and Librarian. SUNO alternative unleashed on your Linux and Windows machine with Nvidia CUDA and Intel Arc. Open Source, Engaged & Musical.
summary: A full music studio and WebUI for YuE2 (YuE): songs from words on your own GPU. Score first (ABC/MIDI), LoRA training, stems, remaster, upscale, lyrics check, DAW export. yue2.cpp · 7 languages · OSEM: Open Source, Engaged & Musical
